summary: Displays and optionally edits GPU-rendered 2D text in a panel, with direct Text mode, Specification DAT/CHOP multi-block mode, formatting codes, numeric/time formatting, wrapping, and callbacks.

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Use the Text parameter or Specification DAT/CHOP mode

key_params.name: text
key_params.note: Source text value; editable panels can write back to this value or bound source

key_params.name: specdat
key_params.note: Specification table with x, y, text, and optional formatting columns

key_params.name: specchop
key_params.note: Numeric per-row attributes matching Specification DAT rows

key_params.name: type
key_params.note: String, Float, Integer, Multi Line, or Password interpretation

key_params.name: formatting
key_params.note: Default, C++ Fmt, Python f-string, numeric, percentage, or time-code formatting

key_params.name: customformatting
key_params.note: Format string used by custom formatting modes

key_params.name: framerate
key_params.note: Frames per second for integer time-code formatting

key_params.name: escapeseq
key_params.note: Parse escape sequences in Specification DAT mode

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Wrap multiline text to panel width

key_params.name: editmode
key_params.note: Locked, editable, select-only, or continuous editable behavior

key_params.name: fontfile
key_params.note: Explicit font file for fonts not registered with the operating system

key_params.name: scaletofit
key_params.note: Shrink or fill text to fit the panel bounds

key_params.name: fontsizeunits
key_params.note: Font sizing in panel units, fractions, points, or pixels depending on mode

key_params.name: dragdropmode
key_params.note: Use panel drag/drop, insert, replace, or append text

key_params.name: fieldfocus
key_params.note: Focus order table for Tab and Shift-Tab editing

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Python callbacks for text and focus changes

key_concepts: raw edit value with formatted display
string, numeric, percentage, and time-code formatting
common_gotchas: Editable mode writes back to the Text parameter or bound source, so bind targets can be changed by panel users.
Editable Continuous Update writes every key stroke and can create heavy recooking or premature validation side effects.
Specification DAT mode requires a text column and matching CHOP samples for per-row numeric overrides.
Text in Specification DAT mode is not directly editable through the panel.
Word Wrap only applies to Multi Line type and still depends on panel width and padding.
Escape sequence parsing is for Specification DAT mode; use Python expression mode for newlines in Text mode.
Password mode is only a visual display mode and should not be treated as secure secret handling.
Text COMP replaces Field COMP and adds features, so avoid planning deprecated Field COMP for new panels.
Fonts that have not been used before may incur setup delay when selected.
build_relevance: 2025.30000+ Slug-based editable text panel and Field COMP replacement
